records.title: 10-Q FIRST QUARTER 2021
records.text: Total sales for the first quarter of fiscal 2021 were $111.5 million, as compared to $57.2 million in the first quarter of fiscal 2020 and $113.0 million in the first quarter of fiscal 2019.

records.title: 10-Q FIRST QUARTER 2021
records.text: Stores that have been open for 13 months are included in comparable sales.

records.title: 10-Q FIRST QUARTER 2021
records.text: As of May 1, 2021, our inventory decreased approximately $19.9 million to $88.4 million, as compared to $108.3 million at May 2, 2020.

records.title: 10-Q FIRST QUARTER 2021
records.text: Another key initiative we pursued in fiscal 2020 was to restructure our overall sales promotional strategy to improve our gross margins.

records.title: 10-Q FIRST QUARTER 2021
records.text: Historically, and consistent with the retail industry, we have experienced seasonal fluctuations as it relates to our operating income and net income.
